text: 【XX证券】您的账户涉嫌违规交易已被限制，请登录 zq-jd2016.cc 解冻
textEn: [XX Securities] Your account is restricted for suspicious trading. Unfreeze it at zq-jd2016.cc
why: 冒充证券公司，解冻链接是钓鱼网站。
whyEn: It impersonates a brokerage; the unfreeze link is phishing.

text: 【中国联通】您获得话费返还 150 元，请下载客户端 lt-fh2016.cc 领取
textEn: [China Unicom] You've earned a 150-yuan bill refund. Download the app at lt-fh2016.cc to claim it.
why: 让你下载来路不明的客户端，多半是木马。
whyEn: It asks you to install an app from an unknown site, likely malware.

text: 【法院】您有一张传票未领取，请登录 fy-cp2016.cc 查看，逾期将强制执行
textEn: [Court] You have an unclaimed summons. View it at fy-cp2016.cc or face enforcement.
why: 法院不会短信发链接送传票，冒充公检法。
whyEn: Courts don't deliver summonses by text link; it's an impersonation scam.

text: 这里是市公安局，您涉嫌一起洗钱案，请立即回电 010-****2016 配合调查
textEn: This is the city police. You're suspected of money laundering. Call 010-****2016 at once.
why: 公安不会发短信让你回电「配合调查」，冒充公检法。
whyEn: Police don't text you to call back about a case; it's an impersonation scam.

text: 【ETC】您的 ETC 卡已过期失效，请登录 etc-sj2016.cc 认证，逾期停用
textEn: [ETC] Your toll card has expired. Verify at etc-sj2016.cc or it will be suspended.
why: ETC 认证不走陌生链接，是钓鱼网站。
whyEn: ETC verification never goes through a random link; it's phishing.

text: 【XX航空】您的航班改签成功，请点 hb-gq2016.cc 确认并领取延误补偿 200 元
textEn: [XX Airlines] Your flight change is done. Confirm at hb-gq2016.cc and claim 200 yuan delay compensation.
why: 你没改签就收到改签短信，还要点链接领钱，是诈骗。
whyEn: A rebooking you never made plus a link to claim money is a scam.

text: 同学你好，凭学生证即可贷款 1 万，无抵押秒到账，加 QQ 2016****88
textEn: Hi student, borrow 10,000 yuan with just your student ID, no collateral, instant. Add QQ 2016****88.
why: 无抵押校园贷，利息高得吓人，是陷阱。
whyEn: Collateral-free campus loans carry crushing interest; it's a trap.

text: 招聘淘宝兼职刷单，日结 200-500，在家用手机就能做，加 QQ 52****16
textEn: Part-time order-brushing job, 200-500 a day, from home on your phone. Add QQ 52****16.
why: 刷单兼职是骗局，先让你垫钱再卷款跑。
whyEn: Order-brushing jobs are scams that take your advance and vanish.

text: 您的好友为您点播了一首歌曲，请点击 dg-2016.cc 收听
textEn: A friend has dedicated a song to you. Listen at dg-2016.cc.
why: 「点播歌曲」是老牌木马链接。
whyEn: The 'song dedication' link is a classic malware trap.

text: 老同学，这是上次聚会的照片，你看看 xc-2016.cc/k8x
textEn: Old classmate, here are the photos from our reunion: xc-2016.cc/k8x
why: 像熟人，但照片放在陌生网址，点开就中木马。
whyEn: It sounds like a friend, but the photos sit on a strange link that installs malware.

text: 您的孩子在学校突发急病，正在医院抢救，请速汇 3 万手术费到 6222****2016
textEn: Your child collapsed at school and is in surgery. Wire 30,000 yuan to 6222****2016 now.
why: 用急事吓你转账，先打电话给孩子和老师核实。
whyEn: It scares you into wiring money; call your child and teacher first.

text: 王老师：下周春游费 120 元，请家长加我新微信 wls2016 转账，旧号不用了
textEn: Ms Wang: The spring outing fee is 120 yuan. Parents, add my new WeChat wls2016 to pay; the old one is gone.
why: 像老师通知，但「换了新号」再让你转账，是冒充。
whyEn: It looks like a teacher, but a new account plus a payment request means an impostor.

text: 恭喜您的号码在本店周年庆抽中 iPad 一台，需先付 200 元邮费，联系 186****2016
textEn: Congrats! Your number won an iPad in our anniversary draw. Pay 200 yuan shipping first: 186****2016.
why: 中奖还要先交钱，就是骗局。
whyEn: A prize that requires paying first is a scam.

text: 【欧洲杯】竞猜送彩金！注册即送 188，猜中冠军 1 赔 8，详见 ozb-2016.cc
textEn: [Euro Cup] Free betting credit! Sign up for 188, pick the champion at 8-to-1: ozb-2016.cc
why: 借欧洲杯拉人赌球，是赌博广告。
whyEn: It uses the Euro Cup to lure you into gambling.

text: 【高考志愿】内部渠道，低分上重点大学，名额有限，联系张老师 139****2016
textEn: [College applications] Insider route into top universities with low scores. Limited spots. Call Mr Zhang 139****2016.
why: 录取只看分数和正规志愿，「内部名额」是骗钱。
whyEn: Admission goes by scores and official forms; 'insider spots' are a con.

text: 【里约奥运】为中国队加油！转发集赞领 288 元红包，点击 ay-2016.cc
textEn: [Rio Olympics] Cheer for Team China! Collect likes for a 288-yuan red packet at ay-2016.cc
why: 蹭奥运热点骗点链接，红包是假的。
whyEn: It rides the Olympics hype to get clicks; the red packet is fake.

text: 【双十一】您的购物津贴 500 元已到账，点击 tm11-2016.cc 领取
textEn: [Double 11] Your 500-yuan shopping allowance has arrived. Claim it at tm11-2016.cc
why: 购物津贴在购物 App 里领，不会发陌生链接。
whyEn: Shopping allowances live inside the shopping app, not on strange links.

text: 【集五福】差一张敬业福？回复 1 获取万能福卡，仅需 9.9 元
textEn: [Five Blessings] Missing the Dedication card? Reply 1 to get a wildcard for just 9.9 yuan.
why: 福卡不能花钱买，回复就扣费。
whyEn: Blessing cards can't be bought; replying triggers a charge.

text: 【XX快递】您有一件到付包裹，因超重需补交运费 12 元，请点 kd-bf2016.cc
textEn: [XX Express] Your cash-on-delivery parcel is overweight. Pay 12 yuan extra at kd-bf2016.cc
why: 补运费让你点链接付款，是钓鱼网站。
whyEn: Asking you to pay extra shipping via a link is phishing.

text: 【客服】您购买的宝贝有质量问题，可三倍退款，请加 QQ 88****2016 办理
textEn: [Customer service] Your item has a quality defect; get a triple refund via QQ 88****2016.
why: 冒充客服退款，加 QQ 后会骗你转账。
whyEn: Fake refund 'service' that leads you to transfer money.

text: 本公司长期出售各类学历证书、成绩单，可查可验，电话 158****2016
textEn: We sell diplomas and transcripts, all verifiable. Call 158****2016.
why: 卖假证是违法广告。
whyEn: Selling fake certificates is an illegal ad.

text: 本店诚招代理，零投资一部手机月入过万，详情加微信 wsdl2016
textEn: Agents wanted! Zero investment, earn 10,000+ a month with one phone. WeChat wsdl2016.
why: 群发的微商拉人广告，「零投资月入过万」不可信。
whyEn: Mass-sent micro-seller recruiting; 'zero investment, 10k a month' isn't real.

text: 【医保中心】您的医保卡涉嫌违规套现已被冻结，请回电 0**-****2016
textEn: [Medical Insurance Center] Your card is frozen for suspected fraud. Call 0**-****2016.
why: 冒充医保中心吓你，回电后就转到「公安」骗钱。
whyEn: It impersonates the insurance office to scare you into a call.

text: 您的话费已欠费停机，请立即点击 hf-jf2016.cc 充值恢复，否则销号
textEn: Your line is suspended for unpaid bills. Top up at hf-jf2016.cc now or lose your number.
why: 充值要走官方渠道，这个网址是假的。
whyEn: Top-ups go through official channels; this site is fake.

text: 【交警】您的车辆有违章未处理，请登录 jj-wz2016.cc 查询并缴纳罚款
textEn: [Traffic police] Your vehicle has unpaid violations. Check and pay at jj-wz2016.cc
why: 违章要去官方平台查，这个链接是钓鱼网站。
whyEn: Violations are checked on official sites; this link is phishing.

text: 出售六合彩特码资料，包中包赢，联系 137****2016
textEn: Selling 'guaranteed' lottery tips, sure win. Call 137****2016.
why: 赌博加诈骗广告，没有包中的事。
whyEn: Gambling scam ad; nothing is guaranteed.

text: 亲，您在我店买的耳机需二次支付才能发货，请点 zf-2016.cc 补款
textEn: Dear, your headphones need a second payment before shipping. Pay at zf-2016.cc
why: 付过款还要「二次支付」，是骗局。
whyEn: A 'second payment' after you've paid is a scam.

text: 急招在家打字员，兼职日赚 300，需先交 98 元入会费
textEn: Typists wanted, work from home, earn 300 a day. 98-yuan membership fee first.
why: 找工作先交钱，是骗局。
whyEn: Paying to get a job is a scam.

text: 【Apple】您的 Apple ID 在异地登录已被锁定，请到 apple-id2016.cc 解锁
textEn: [Apple] Your Apple ID was locked after a login elsewhere. Unlock it at apple-id2016.cc
why: 网址不是官方的，是骗账号密码的钓鱼网站。
whyEn: Not an official site; it phishes for your password.

text: iPhone 7 港版首发 3999 包邮，先付全款再发货，加 QQ 77****2016
textEn: Hong Kong iPhone 7 at launch, 3,999 shipped. Pay in full first. QQ 77****2016.
why: 新机低价、先付全款，付了就联系不上。
whyEn: A cheap new phone paid in full upfront means the seller vanishes.

text: 【三星】Note7 召回补偿 500 元已到账，回复身份证号领取
textEn: [Samsung] Your 500-yuan Note7 recall compensation has arrived. Reply with your ID number.
why: 索要身份证号，是骗个人信息。
whyEn: It asks for your ID number to steal personal data.

text: 【校园网】您的账号流量异常将被停用，请点 xyw-2016.cc 输入学号和密码验证
textEn: [Campus network] Abnormal traffic on your account. Verify your student ID and password at xyw-2016.cc
why: 学校不会让你在陌生网址输密码。
whyEn: Schools never ask for passwords on a strange site.

text: 棋牌室线上版开业，充 100 送 50，天天返水，网址 qp-2016.cc
textEn: Online card room now open! Top up 100 get 50, daily rebates: qp-2016.cc
why: 线上棋牌返水就是赌博。
whyEn: Online card rooms with rebates are gambling.

text: 恭喜获得《XX 游戏》内测资格，充值 30 元送 3000 钻石，链接 yx-2016.cc
textEn: You got beta access to 'XX Game'! Top up 30 for 3,000 gems: yx-2016.cc
why: 充值送大量道具，是骗充值的假链接。
whyEn: Huge bonuses for a top-up on a fake link is a scam.

text: 【淘宝】您的账户存在异常交易，资金已被冻结，请联系客服 400-***-2016
textEn: [Taobao] Abnormal activity on your account; funds frozen. Call 400-***-2016.
why: 冒充平台客服，号码不是官方的。
whyEn: It impersonates the platform; the number isn't official.

text: 急！你朋友在派出所，需要交 5000 保证金才能放人，速转 6222****1314
textEn: Urgent! Your friend is at the police station. Send 5,000 bail to 6222****1314.
why: 派出所不会让人转账到私人卡，是诈骗。
whyEn: Police never ask for transfers to a personal card.

text: 【社保局】您的社保补贴 1860 元待领取，请登录 sb-bt2016.cc 填写银行卡
textEn: [Social Security] A 1,860-yuan subsidy awaits you. Enter your bank card at sb-bt2016.cc
why: 让你在陌生网址填银行卡，是钓鱼。
whyEn: Entering your card on a strange site is phishing.

text: 【通信管理局】您的号码涉嫌发送诈骗短信，将于 24 小时内停机，详询 0**-****2016
textEn: [Telecom Authority] Your number sent fraud texts and will be cut off in 24 hours. Call 0**-****2016.
why: 吓你回电，接着冒充公安要你转账。
whyEn: It scares you into calling, then fake police demand money.

text: 【欧洲杯】买球就上 ozq-2016.cc，首存 100 送 100，冰岛赢球你也赢
textEn: [Euro Cup] Bet at ozq-2016.cc: deposit 100 get 100, win with Iceland!
why: 赌球网站广告。
whyEn: An online betting ad.

text: 【XX银行】您尾号 0524 的卡消费 3888.00 元，如非本人操作请致电 400-***-2016
textEn: [XX Bank] Card ending 0524 spent 3,888.00. Not you? Call 400-***-2016.
why: 像动账提醒，但留的不是银行官方号码，回电就被骗。
whyEn: It looks like a bank alert, but the number isn't the bank's.

text: 【菜鸟驿站】您的包裹已到，取件码 5531，取件前请先在 cn-yz2016.cc 验证身份
textEn: [Cainiao] Your parcel is here, code 5531. Verify your identity at cn-yz2016.cc first.
why: 有取件码看着很真，但取件不用上网站验证身份。
whyEn: The pickup code looks real, but pickup never needs an online ID check.

text: 您的 QQ 已被盗，好友正收到借钱消息，请立即点击 qq-ss2016.cc 申诉冻结
textEn: Your QQ was hacked and friends are getting loan requests. Appeal at qq-ss2016.cc now.
why: 借「被盗」吓你，链接是骗密码的。
whyEn: It uses a 'hacked' scare; the link steals your password.

text: 【XX银行】您尾号 2218 的卡已绑定快捷支付，如非本人操作请拨打卡背面客服电话
textEn: [XX Bank] Card ending 2218 linked to quick pay. Not you? Call the number on the back of your card.
why: 让你打卡背面的官方电话，不是短信里的陌生号码。
whyEn: It points to the number on your card, not one in the text.

text: 【建设银行】您尾号 6612 的账户 6 月 2 日工资收入 3850.00 元，余额 4012.35 元
textEn: [CCB] Account ending 6612 received salary 3,850.00 on June 2. Balance 4,012.35.
why: 正常的动账提醒，没有链接也没让你回电。
whyEn: A normal account alert with no link and no call request.

text: 【支付宝】验证码 482915，您正在进行登录操作，切勿告诉他人
textEn: [Alipay] Code 482915 for login. Never tell anyone.
why: 官方验证码，还提醒你别告诉别人。
whyEn: An official code that warns you not to share it.

text: 【中通快递】您的包裹已放至小区快递柜，取件码 68213，请及时领取
textEn: [ZTO] Your parcel is in the community locker, code 68213. Please collect it.
why: 正常的取件通知。
whyEn: A normal pickup notice.

text: 【中国联通】截至 6 月 1 日，您的账户余额 8.50 元，请及时充值
textEn: [China Unicom] As of June 1, your balance is 8.50 yuan. Please top up.
why: 余额提醒，没有链接。
whyEn: A balance reminder with no link.

text: 【市一中】6 月 7 日至 8 日学校作高考考点，高一高二学生放假两天
textEn: [No.1 High School] The school hosts the gaokao on June 7-8; Grades 10-11 get two days off.
why: 学校的正常通知，没让交钱。
whyEn: A normal school notice that asks for no money.

text: 妈：你爸腰疼好多了，别担心，周末记得回家吃饭
textEn: Mom: Dad's back is much better, don't worry. Come home for dinner this weekend.
why: 家里人的日常消息。
whyEn: An everyday message from family.

text: 表哥：我那台旧电脑开机老蓝屏，你周末有空帮我看看不
textEn: Cousin: My old PC keeps blue-screening at boot. Can you look at it this weekend?
why: 熟人找你帮忙，没涉及钱。
whyEn: A relative asking a favor, no money involved.

text: 【京东】您的订单正由配送员小王派送，联系电话 139****8866，请保持电话畅通
textEn: [JD] Courier Wang is delivering your order, phone 139****8866. Keep your phone on.
why: 正常的派送通知，没让你点链接。
whyEn: A normal delivery notice with no link.

text: 【12306】您的退票已办理成功，退款 102.50 元将原路退回
textEn: [12306] Your refund is done. 102.50 yuan will return to the original payment.
why: 正常的退票通知。
whyEn: A normal ticket refund notice.

text: 【微信】验证码 7392，用于绑定手机，请勿泄露给任何人，包括客服
textEn: [WeChat] Code 7392 to bind your phone. Never share it with anyone, including staff.
why: 正常验证码，明确提醒别泄露。
whyEn: A normal code that clearly warns against sharing.

text: 【公司行政】周五下午 3 点消防演练，请大家提前保存电脑上的文件
textEn: [Office admin] Fire drill Friday at 3 p.m. Save your work beforehand.
why: 公司的正常通知。
whyEn: A normal workplace notice.

text: 【某某大学】录取通知书已由 EMS 寄出，请凭单号查询，学校不会短信催缴学费
textEn: [XX University] Your admission letter was sent by EMS. We never text for tuition.
why: 正规录取通知，还提醒你防骗。
whyEn: A real admission notice that even warns about scams.

text: 【中国移动】您本月已用通话 268 分钟，套餐剩余 32 分钟，发送 CXYE 到 10086 可查询
textEn: [China Mobile] 268 call minutes used, 32 left. Text CXYE to 10086 to check.
why: 正常的用量提醒，只让你发短信到 10086。
whyEn: A normal usage alert; it only points you to 10086.

text: 阿杰：今晚三点德国对意大利，来网吧通宵看球不
textEn: Ajie: Germany vs Italy at 3 a.m. tonight. Coming to the internet cafe to watch?
why: 朋友约看球。
whyEn: A friend inviting you to watch a match.

text: 【气象台】今夜到明天有暴雨，请减少外出，注意防范
textEn: [Weather bureau] Heavy rain tonight through tomorrow. Stay in and stay safe.
why: 天气预警，没有链接。
whyEn: A weather warning with no link.

text: 【顺丰速运】您的快件已签收，签收人：门卫，感谢使用顺丰
textEn: [SF Express] Your parcel was signed for by the gatekeeper. Thank you.
why: 正常的签收通知。
whyEn: A normal delivery receipt.

text: 同事：明早会议改到 9 点半，PPT 我放共享盘了
textEn: Colleague: Tomorrow's meeting moved to 9:30. Slides are on the shared drive.
why: 同事的工作消息。
whyEn: A work message from a colleague.

text: 爸：今年集五福我就差个敬业福，你有多的给我一张
textEn: Dad: I'm only missing the Dedication card this year. Send me one if you have a spare.
why: 提到集五福，但只是家人要福卡，没链接没要钱。
whyEn: It mentions the blessings, but it's family asking for a card, no link or money.

text: 【XX银行】您尾号 3307 的信用卡本期账单 1260.50 元，到期还款日 10 月 25 日
textEn: [XX Bank] Card ending 3307 statement: 1,260.50, due Oct 25.
why: 正常的账单提醒，没有链接。
whyEn: A normal statement reminder with no link.

text: 房东：楼下水管修好了，今天晚上可以用热水了
textEn: Landlord: The pipe downstairs is fixed. Hot water is back tonight.
why: 房东的日常通知，没提钱。
whyEn: Routine landlord news, nothing about money.

text: 【菜鸟驿站】您的包裹已到 6 号楼驿站，营业时间 9:00-21:00，取件码 2-4-0618
textEn: [Cainiao] Your parcel is at Building 6, open 9:00-21:00, code 2-4-0618.
why: 正常取件通知。
whyEn: A normal pickup notice.

text: 【中国电信】您申请的宽带提速已生效，下行 50M，感谢使用
textEn: [China Telecom] Your broadband upgrade to 50M is active. Thank you.
why: 你自己办的业务回执。
whyEn: A receipt for a service you ordered.

text: 【市实验小学】本周六补课，请家长督促孩子按时到校，不收取任何费用
textEn: [Experimental Primary] Classes this Saturday. Please send kids on time. No fees.
why: 学校通知，还说明不收费。
whyEn: A school notice that says no fees.

text: 【Apple】您的 Apple ID 验证码是 552310，请勿与他人共享
textEn: [Apple] Your Apple ID code is 552310. Do not share it.
why: 正常验证码，没链接。
whyEn: A normal code with no link.

text: 老同学：下月 18 号同学聚会，老地方，来不来回个话
textEn: Old classmate: Reunion on the 18th next month, usual place. Let me know.
why: 熟人约聚会，没链接没要钱。
whyEn: A friend inviting you, no link or money.

text: 【中国移动】您已成功缴费 50.00 元，当前余额 62.30 元
textEn: [China Mobile] Payment of 50.00 received. Balance 62.30.
why: 正常缴费回执。
whyEn: A normal payment receipt.

text: 姐：女排夺冠了！你看了没，我在单位都喊出声了
textEn: Sis: Volleyball team won gold! Did you see? I yelled at work.
why: 家人分享喜悦。
whyEn: Family sharing the excitement.

text: 【XX航空】您的航班因天气原因延误，新起飞时间请以机场广播为准
textEn: [XX Airlines] Your flight is delayed by weather. Listen for airport announcements.
why: 像航班短信诈骗，但没链接没电话，只是提醒。
whyEn: It looks like a flight scam but has no link or number, just a notice.

text: 【10086】您的积分将于年底清零，可编辑短信 JF 发送到 10086 查询兑换
textEn: [10086] Your points expire at year end. Text JF to 10086 to redeem.
why: 同是积分清零，但只让你发短信到 10086，不是陌生网址。
whyEn: Same points story, but it only points to 10086, not a strange site.

text: 【医院】您预约的 6 月 5 日上午内科门诊，请携带身份证按时就诊
textEn: [Hospital] Your internal medicine appointment is June 5 a.m. Bring your ID.
why: 正常预约提醒。
whyEn: A normal appointment reminder.

text: 【省考试院】高考成绩 6 月 23 日起可在官网查询，查分不收取任何费用
textEn: [Exam authority] Gaokao scores available on the official site from June 23. Free of charge.
why: 官方通知，强调不收费。
whyEn: An official notice stressing it's free.

text: 室友：双十一你帮我抢的耳机到了没，到了放我桌上
textEn: Roommate: Did the headphones you grabbed for me on Double 11 arrive? Leave them on my desk.
why: 室友的日常消息。
whyEn: An everyday message from a roommate.

text: 【中国移动】您的号码存在异常，请携带身份证到就近营业厅办理，切勿轻信来电和链接
textEn: [China Mobile] Issue with your number. Visit a store with your ID. Don't trust calls or links.
why: 说「异常」像吓人，但只让你去营业厅，还提醒防骗。
whyEn: 'Issue' sounds scary, but it only sends you to a store and warns about scams.
